verdict.rationale: Claude Code explicitly advertises agentic search that 'maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds' to understand project structure and dependencies without manual context selection, plus CLAUDE.md for persisting architecture/coding-standard context across sessions — directly supporting codebase orientation for new changes. Community evidence corroborates real usage across large multi-language codebases, though also notes occasional confusion on complex files, suggesting comprehension isn't perfect. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or hands-on account specifically validating codebase-mapping/onboarding accuracy, and no visual codebase-map UI evidence.
